title: Plate layout drawn from the topology optimiser
summary: The base plate is the optimiser's load path made printable: no hub-to-motor arms; each motor seat hangs on 4 ribbed spokes (1.3 mm x 4.8 mm ribs) from its own duct ring, the hub reaches the four duct-to-duct webs on ribbed bridges, and the webs are 6 mm tall. Judged by the same 2.5D plate FE on the exact printed layout: first mode 286 Hz vs 187 Hz for the hand-drawn arms at the same webs, crash compliance 2.2x lower, for +0.8 g.

rejected.why: first mode 187 Hz, under C4's 200 Hz
its spokes were 0.75 mm blades; the 1.6 mm minimum-member clean-up deleted them and cut the motor seats loose (first mode 7 Hz)
first mode 213 Hz; 6 mm gives 283 Hz for 0.12 g
